name: John W. Keker
tagline: Top rated White Collar Crimes attorney in San Francisco, California
about: John W. Keker is an attorney providing legal services covering Criminal Defense: White Collar, Business Litigation and Intellectual Property Litigation.

John Keker, who practices law in San Francisco, California, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Yale Law School. He graduated in 1970. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1971.
